# plugins/

**Generated. Do not edit.** Each folder is one installable bundle, built from the `bundles:` mapping in `pm-skills.config.yaml` by `scripts/build-plugins.py`. The source of truth is `skills/`.

- [`pm-determine`](pm-determine/README.md): Set outcomes and read the terrain: strategy, finance, market, customers.
- [`pm-discover`](pm-discover/README.md): Find and frame the real problem.
- [`pm-define`](pm-define/README.md): Shape a solution worth building and test the bet.
- [`pm-develop`](pm-develop/README.md): Turn the chosen solution into buildable work.
- [`pm-deliver`](pm-deliver/README.md): Take it to market, measure it, and retire it well.
- [`pm-drive`](pm-drive/README.md): Drive your career and your stakeholders.
